purpose: CHAMP-ONLY, HALF-RISK single-XAU trend follower for a FundingPips-rules account (daily -5% / overall -10%). Long-only champion recipe, discrete trade-ticket engine (src.v5.xau_trend.run_trades, exit=trail). Run: `python scripts/v5_xau_dual.py --bot champ --config configs/v5_xau_champ_fundingpips.json --live --execute`. The cent dual book (configs/v5_xau_dual.json) is UNTOUCHED.
validated_by: data/v5_runs challenge sim (fp_survive.py 2026-07-27): champ @0.5% risk -> ~95.5% survival, 0% daily-breach, 2.9% overall-breach vs FundingPips 5%/10%. ls DROPPED (blew both limits: 23% daily / 27% overall even at 1% risk). See V5_FINDINGS.
_risk_note: risk_frac 0.005 = HALF the cent book's 1%. This is THE lever that makes a single-XAU trend follower survive the 10% overall wall: at 1% it breaches ~19% of the time (native maxDD -14.8%); at 0.5% breach drops to 2.9% and daily is never touched. Do NOT raise it. 0.33% (risk_frac 0.0033) is even safer (~0.4% breach) if you want margin.

guards._note: The dual engine only carries per-trade SL + trail; it does NOT enforce the firm's daily/overall lines. On a live FundingPips account ALSO run a guard pass that flattens champ (magic 360544) at ~3.5% daily / ~8% overall from the firm anchors — reuse the basket executor's --guard-only pattern, or a small dedicated guard. Without it the -5%/-10% lines are unmonitored between H4 passes.

_deploy_note: FundingPips restricts weekend holding on master (see fundingpips-b-account-plan). This single-XAU trend bot holds through weekends by construction; for a FUNDED FP account it would also need a Friday-flatten. For a CHALLENGE where weekends are allowed it runs as-is. Symbol name: verify XAUUSD (or XAUUSDmicro on a small account) live on the FP terminal.
